asset_integrity_policy: Full weight SHA from immutable just-completed asset receipt; probe checks size/inode/mtime stability, rehashes small configs, verifies native loading and all parameter keys/shapes/dtypes. No second16GB SHA scan falsely claimed.
RNG_policy: Reset torch.manual_seed and torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(20261024) before each fresh row; cache0/73 are separately seeded first generation. Not continuous RNG equivalence.
tokenizer_policy: Published JSON raw/generic full backend identical; all80 input IDs and roundtrip checked against new all80CPU contract. No AutoTokenizer Llama reconstruction.

actual_rotary.tolerance_basis: 8 FP32 eps relative for elementary pow/div/mul evaluation across devices; no absolute floor, no dtype casting or model/config change

limitation: Only exact F1 fixed80; rejected/missing responses are abstentions, no semantic repairs or negative-label claims. No quality evaluated in this process.
